summary_en: Toyota expanded its share buyback authorization to 610 million shares (5.18% of outstanding shares) with a maximum purchase price of 1.3 trillion yen, adding a public tender offer method alongside market purchases for the period through August 4, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Partial Modifications to Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock, Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Public Tender Offer for Treasury Stock, and Partial Modifications to Matters Related to Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, Toyota's board of directors resolved to expand the share buyback authorization originally approved on August 4, 2026. The maximum number of shares to be acquired was increased from 500 million shares (4.22% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of June 30, 2026) to 610 million shares (5.18% of outstanding shares as of September 30, 2026). The maximum aggregate purchase price was raised from 1 trillion yen to 1.3 trillion yen. The acquisition period remains unchanged at August 5, 2026 through August 4, 2027.

The company added a public tender offer method alongside the existing market purchase approach. The buyback is intended to improve capital efficiency in response to market valuation and prevailing stock price levels. Toyota stated that it pursues shareholder value enhancement as a key management principle and aims to increase dividends on a stable and continuous basis. The company also emphasized that retained earnings will be directed toward next-generation growth investments in environmental and safety technologies to achieve a carbon-neutral society, while contributing to the interests of all stakeholders including employees, business partners, and communities.
